name: 2019-2c-parcial2
title: Mars Rover with Ground Sensor and Safe Movement
description: A Mars Rover that processes command strings (f, b, l, r) with polymorphic headings is given. The student must add single-digit command repetition (digit + 2 times), a ground sensor with Earth/Ice/Rock ground types that change or forbid movement, and a parenthesized 'safe movement' state that undoes all movements when anything fails inside it.

design.notes: Three orthogonal features interact: ground types must become polymorphic objects returned by an injected sensor (with randomness on ice to control in tests), safe/unsafe processing is a state machine with parenthesis parsing and nested/unterminated error cases, and undo requires recording inverse movements per heading.
